audience: nonprofit fundraising teams that run donation forms in CharityStack

useCases.title: Review recent gifts
useCases.text: List one-time gifts and recurring charges, newest first. Open one payment to see its fund and form.

useCases.title: Check cancelled recurring gifts
useCases.text: List the recurring subscriptions by status. Open one to see its amount, frequency and next billing date.

useCases.title: Find a donor and their giving
useCases.text: Search donor contacts by email. Open one contact for its consent state and lifetime giving.

useCases.title: Review donation forms
useCases.text: List the donation and event forms, then open one to read its giving levels, tickets and custom inputs.

useCases.title: Cancel or change a recurring gift
useCases.text: Cancel a recurring subscription, reactivate it, or change its amount in US dollars. Confirm the change with the donor first.

useCases.title: Add a donor contact
useCases.text: Create a donor contact. Set SMS consent only when the person gave explicit SMS consent.
